title: LearningHistory
description: Design Knowledge Engine (Phase 6.5) Section 10 — locally-recorded usage history, distinct from workbench/workbenchFavorites.ts's explicit star-toggle favorites: this tracks implicit usage frequency (how often a Style DNA/Palette/Motif was actually used) and recently-generated collections, not what the user starred. Exported/imported as this exact shape.

styleDnaUsage.description: Style DNA id -> use count. Per-value shape (number >= 0) is enforced by knowledge/history's own TypeScript types and normalizeLearningHistory, not by this schema — the hand-rolled validator (validators/jsonSchemaValidator.ts) only supports a boolean additionalProperties, not a per-key value schema.

paletteUsage.description: Palette id -> use count. See styleDnaUsage's note on per-value validation.

motifUsage.description: Motif Grammar category id -> use count. See styleDnaUsage's note on per-value validation.

recentCollections.description: Most-recent-first, capped at RECENT_COLLECTIONS_LIMIT by the recording function (not by this schema).
